anchor_value: issuer_name required; raw row has no company or investment terms and is a subtotal/rollup line, not a position

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Company cell blank; Type of Investment blank; Outstanding Principal 2,549; Cost 2,596; Fair Value 271

findings.detail: A blank-company subtotal/rollup line was included as a holding, producing a position with missing issuer_name.

rationale: C201 requires issuer_name for position identity. In the raw SOI grid, table 33 row 6 has an empty Company cell and empty Type of Investment cell, with only subtotal-like numeric principal/cost/fair-value amounts following the preceding Rally Network rows. Treating that row as a holding yields a blank issuer_name, so the flag is a real extraction/subtotal-leak error rather than a false alarm.
